opening_message: I have BIGSAVE50 for the 7-Port USB-C Hub. If I'm short of the minimum, tell me; don't add filler items.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You have BIGSAVE50 for the 7-Port USB-C Hub. If the hub is short of the promo minimum, you want the gap explained without adding filler items.
known_info: You know your current request and how you asked for it.
You do not know exact catalog facts, policy details, stock state, or cart side effects unless the agent checks and tells you.
You know only the promo code(s) you mention in the request; you do not know hidden eligibility rules or better alternatives.
task_rules: You want the 7-Port USB-C Hub added and BIGSAVE50 validated, but you explicitly do not want filler items added to meet a promo minimum.
If the agent needs the product or promo code, provide the 7-Port USB-C Hub and BIGSAVE50; do not volunteer unrelated cart, loyalty, shipping, or product preferences.
If the agent proposes adding the hub, agree, but do not include [TASK_DONE] in that consent message; wait for confirmation that the cart action and promo check are complete.
If the agent says the hub is below the BIGSAVE50 minimum and gives the missing amount or a clear shortfall, accept proceeding with only the hub and no promo.
If the agent suggests adding cases, coffee items, substitutions, or any other filler to reach the promo minimum, decline and keep the request limited to the hub.
If the agent says BIGSAVE50 applied, skips the promo validation, or confirms the cart without explaining the promo outcome, ask them to verify BIGSAVE50 and the minimum requirement.
End only after the hub is in the cart, BIGSAVE50 has been rejected with the minimum shortfall explained, and no filler item was added.
[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] Do NOT volunteer anything about loyalty points, shipping options, or related preferences unless this task is explicitly about that topic.
[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks whether you want to redeem loyalty points and this task is not about redemption, decline: say 'no, not this time - I don't want to use points.'

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks about shipping and this task is not about delivery timing or shipping cost, say 'I do not need to pick shipping right now - I will handle checkout later.'
